questions.question: Dr. Imad has a 16-year-old patient who wants orthodontic treatment. The parents are against it. According to the principle of autonomy and Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, how should he proceed?
options: Perform the treatment because the patient requests it
Respect the parents' opinion because the patient is a minor
Refer the matter to the guardianship judge
Perform the treatment with the Order's approval
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'For a minor, parental consent is mandatory. I must respect their decision while explaining the benefits of treatment.' Dr. Imad: 'I will organize a meeting with the parents.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous discovers that his colleague uses a scientifically unvalidated technique. According to Article 42 of the Code of Ethics, what is the procedure to follow?
options: Inform the colleague's patient
Confidentially notify his colleague of his reservations
File a complaint directly with the Order
Ignore the situation
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Article 42 requires notifying one's colleague of reservations confidentially before any other action.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will write him a courteous letter.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad is asked to perform an aesthetic surgery procedure he does not master perfectly. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Perform the procedure to satisfy the patient
Refuse and refer to a specialist colleague
Perform the procedure with the help of a colleague
Perform the procedure after online training
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must provide informed care in accordance with established knowledge. Referring to a specialist is an act of responsibility.' Dr. Imad: 'I will recommend an aesthetics expert colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who asks him to prescribe an antibiotic for an absent relative. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the response?
options: Prescribe the antibiotic for the relative
Refuse and explain that a prescription requires the relative's consultation
Prescribe a reduced dose
Ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'A prescription requires a direct clinical examination. Prescribing without seeing the patient is a professional fault.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will ask him to bring his relative in.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad receives a patient who has been treated by a colleague and is dissatisfied. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, what is the first step to take?
options: Accept the patient and criticize the colleague
Propose a joint consultation with the first practitioner
Take over the patient without informing the colleague
Refuse the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 53 provides that the second practitioner must propose a joint consultation with the first practitioner.' Dr. Imad: 'I will contact his colleague to organize a consultation.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who wishes his treatment to be carried out outside consultation hours, without other patients knowing. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Accept the patient's request
Refuse because it could create inequalities between patients
Accept if the patient pays a supplement
Accept but without telling other patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must act in a spirit of justice and fairness. Treating a patient outside normal hours without medical justification could create inequalities.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will offer him normal hours.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad discovers that his assistant disclosed confidential information about a patient at a party. According to Article 4 of the Code of Ethics, what is his responsibility?
options: He is not responsible, it is his assistant
He is responsible and must take disciplinary measures
He is partially responsible
He must wait for the patient's complaint
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 4 requires the dentist to ensure that their staff are informed of obligations regarding professional confidentiality. The dentist's responsibility is engaged.' Dr. Imad: 'I will remind my assistant of her obligations and consider sanctions.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is approached by a patient who offers cash payment without an invoice. According to Article 6 of the Code of Ethics, what is the response?
options: Accept because the patient offers it
Refuse because every invoice must be issued
Accept if the patient insists
Ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must issue an invoice for every procedure performed. Accepting payments without an invoice is an ethical and tax violation.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will explain the need for an invoice.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who refuses to give him access to their previous medical record. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He may refuse to treat the patient
He must respect the patient's refusal and inform them of the consequences
He may insist on having the information
He may ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The patient has the right to refuse communication of their file. The dentist must respect this choice while informing the patient of the risks.' Dr. Imad: 'I will respect his decision.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who wishes a treatment he considers unnecessary. According to the principle of non-maleficence, what is the right attitude?
options: Perform the treatment to satisfy the patient
Refuse and explain why the treatment is unnecessary
Perform an alternative treatment
Ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The principle of non-maleficence (do no harm) requires not performing unnecessary procedures. The dentist must refuse and explain the reasons to the patient.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will clearly explain why this treatment is not indicated.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad wishes to create an association with a colleague. According to Article 59 of the Code of Ethics, what is the prerequisite condition?
options: A verbal agreement between the associates
A written contract respecting each person's professional independence
A simple declaration to the council of the order
An agreement with the owner of the premises
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 59 stipulates that there can be no joint practice without a written contract that respects the professional independence of each practitioner.' Dr. Imad: 'I will have a contract drawn up by a lawyer.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who asks him to stop his orthodontic treatment. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what should he do?
options: Stop the treatment without discussion
Inform the patient of the consequences of stopping and respect their choice
Impose the continuation of treatment
Ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The patient has the right to stop treatment. The dentist must inform them of the consequences and respect their decision.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will explain the risks of stopping.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad is confronted with a verbally violent patient. According to ethical rules, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse to treat them
Treat the patient in a secure environment
Ignore the patient's behavior
Request police intervention
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist has a duty to treat, but also has the right to take measures to ensure their safety and that of their staff.' Dr. Imad: 'I will arrange my practice for more security.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who wishes photos of their treatment for social media. According to Article 4 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He may publish the photos if the patient agrees
He must obtain written and explicit consent from the patient
He cannot publish photos of patients
He may publish the photos if they are anonymized
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Publication of photos requires written and explicit consent, in accordance with Article 4 on professional confidentiality and Law 09-08 on data protection.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will prepare a consent form.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad is asked to replace a colleague. According to Article 63 of the Code of Ethics, what is his obligation?
options: Sign the treatment forms in the colleague's name
Personally sign the treatment forms
Use the colleague's stamp
Not sign the treatment forms
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 63 provides that the replacement must personally sign the health insurance forms of the patients they treat.' Dr. Imad: 'I will personally sign each form.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who asks him not to mention a diagnosis in his file. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Accept the patient's request
Refuse because the medical record must be complete and accurate
Note the diagnosis separately
Promise not to note it
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist has an obligation to keep a complete and accurate medical record. Omitting information is a professional fault.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will explain to the patient the importance of a complete file.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad discovers that his colleague performs procedures without professional insurance. According to Article 22 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Ignore the situation
Report to the council of the order that his colleague does not respect his obligations
Inform the colleague's patients
Offer his colleague to get insured
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Professional insurance is mandatory. Not being insured constitutes a fault. Reporting it to the Order helps protect patients.' Dr. Imad: 'I will refer the matter to the council of the order.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who cannot afford to pay for their care. According to Article 7 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse to treat them
Refer them to a public health center
Propose a payment plan
Treat them for free
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must treat all patients with the same conscience, but they are not obliged to treat for free. Proposing a payment plan is a fair solution.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will offer them a payment plan.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a 17-year-old patient who wishes an aesthetic treatment. The parents agree. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Parental consent is sufficient
The minor patient's consent is also required
Aesthetic treatment is forbidden for minors
The Order's approval is required
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Parental consent is necessary, but the minor patient must also consent if they have discernment, especially for aesthetic treatment.' Dr. Imad: 'I will obtain the consent of both the patient and their parents.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is invited to a conference by a laboratory. According to Article 16 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He may accept if the content is scientific
He must declare this partnership to the Order
He must refuse because any form of benefit is prohibited
He may accept if it is continuing education
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Article 16 prohibits any payment, acceptance, or sharing of money between practitioners and third parties. Accepting benefits from a laboratory constitutes an ethical violation.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will decline the invitation.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who wishes a second opinion. According to Article 55 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse the second opinion
Accept and facilitate consultation with a colleague
Impose his treatment
Abandon the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 55 provides that the dentist must agree to meet in consultation with any other practitioner when this consultation is requested by the patient.' Dr. Imad: 'I will recommend a competent colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who has consulted several dentists without success. According to the principle of beneficence, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse the patient
Propose a treatment, but without guarantee of result
Promise a result
Refer the patient to another colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The principle of beneficence requires acting for the patient's well-being. You must propose a realistic treatment without promising a result.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will explain the possibilities and limits.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who needs urgent treatment but has no means of payment. According to Article 7 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse to treat them
Treat them urgently and offer a payment plan
Treat them only if they pay immediately
Refer them to the hospital emergency department
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'In an emergency, the dentist must treat as a priority and find a payment solution later, in accordance with the duty of assistance.' Dr. Imad: 'I will treat them first.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who wishes to be treated under conscious sedation. According to the Code of Ethics, what conditions must be met?
options: No particular conditions
Specific training and appropriate equipment
An anesthetist's agreement
The council of the order's agreement
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Conscious sedation requires specific training and appropriate equipment to guarantee patient safety.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will check my training and equipment.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad, after managing several ethical dilemmas, receives congratulations from Dr. Soundous. What is the next step for Dr. Imad?
options: Become a reference in dental ethics
Retire
Change specialty
Forget good practices
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Mastery of ethical dilemmas is a valuable skill. Becoming a reference in ethics is the next step.' Dr. Imad: 'I will train in medical ethics.'
